translation.title: Analgesic and Anti-inflammatory Plaster
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for the analgesic and anti-inflammatory relief of low back pain, joint pain, muscle pain, bruises, sprains, chilblains, pain from fractures, and stiff shoulders.
translation.usage: Adults apply the patch to the affected area once or twice a day.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine in the following cases: infants under 30 months of age; people who have experienced allergic symptoms caused by natural rubber; the area around the eyes; mucous membranes; eczema; dermatitis caused by lacquer or the like; wounded areas. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before using this medicine in the following cases: people with an allergic constitution; people who have experienced allergic symptoms (such as rash, redness, itching or dermatitis caused by lacquer) from medicines or cosmetics; people with severe moist skin or erosion; children; women who are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding. If your symptoms do not improve after 5 to 6 days of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and directions. When it is used by a child, use it under the supervision of a guardian. This medicine is for external use only. Do not warm the area where the patch is applied with a heater, an electric blanket or the like. Remove it at least 1 hour before bathing and apply it about 30 minutes after bathing. If the affected area is wet with sweat or the like, wipe it dry before use. If a large amount is absorbed through the skin, symptoms of poisoning may occur, so avoid using it on a large area for a long period. Stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist if any of the following occur: rash and redness; itching; pain. Store at room temperature, protected from moisture and light. Keep out of reach of children. Do not use the product after its expiry date.
